normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- Private beach access- Amazing gulf views- Elevator- Community pool- Freestanding ice maker- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The Salty Dog is a luxurious 4–bedroom, 4.5–bathroom Gulf-front home that sleeps 12. Located along the shores of beautiful Inlet Beach, this gorgeous home has upper–level living spaces to take full advantage of Gulf views and 2 balconies. An elevator makes stocking the kitchen a breeze and helps tired legs after a full day’s adventure along 30A.White shiplap walls lend a beach feel to the first floor. Guests staying in the bunk nook, which has 2 twin–over–twin bunk beds, will enjoy a view of the dune walkover and have quick access to the beach. Guests pass a shared hallway bathroom with a shower/tub combo and the elevator before reaching a wet bar with a mini-fridge and a door leading to private beach access.On the second floor, 2 of the 3 guest bedrooms enjoy dazzling Gulf views. A crisp blue and white guest bedroom has a queen bed and a shared hallway bathroom with a shower/tub combo at the stair landing. A second guest bedroom with a queen bed enjoys incredible views of the dune walkover and the Gulf and utilizes the shared hallway bathroom. A third guest bedroom is decorated in soothing shades of cream that don’t compete with the view of dunes and the deep blue of the Gulf. A private bathroom has a shower only.Living spaces are located on the third floor for those sweeping Gulf views. Slipcovered sofas are surrounded by floor–to–ceiling windows and 2 built-in bookcases. Pieces of natural coral, jute ottomans, and wicker baskets provide visual texture and balance the pecky cypress ceiling. The adjacent kitchen has an oversized marble-topped island that seats 5 and contains a wine chiller. White cabinets conceal a premium refrigerator and dishwasher. A rough-hewn dining table sits beneath a chandelier woven with natural fibers in a nook with incredible Gulf views. Glass doors open to a balcony in front of the table. Enjoy warm breezes and look for dolphins while sipping morning coffee, or toast one of the Emerald Coast’s glorious sunsets.A primary bedroom fills the fourth floor. Filled with shades of white, cream, and baby blue, the bedroom has a king bed and a sitting area that enjoys floor–to–ceiling Gulf views. Watch the waves crash from the private bathroom’s glass-enclosed shower or soaking tub. A delightful, bubble–inspired chandelier and dramatic artwork add a bit of fun to the space. The bedroom opens onto a private balcony with incredible views of the beach. Relax and indulge the senses while reclining on an outdoor daybed.Guests will enjoy exploring neighboring Rosemary Beach on 4 included adult bikes. With this location and posh finishes, The Salty Dog will book quickly.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:-Bunk Nook: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate, Private Gulf-front Balcony
